description: This PHP class 'TimeAtWorkLastActionDetails' serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) in the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. It encapsulates details about the last action time at work, including status, timestamps (UTC and user local), and timezone offset, with constructor and getter methods.

classes.name: TimeAtWorkLastActionDetails
classes.description: A DTO class representing details of the last action time at work, including status, UTC and user timestamps, and timezone offset.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the time at work last action details with optional parameters for status, timestamps, and timezone offset.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the status/state of the last action.

methods.name: getUtcDate
methods.description: Returns the UTC date of the last action.

methods.name: getUtcTime
methods.description: Returns the UTC time of the last action.

methods.name: getUserDate
methods.description: Returns the user local date of the last action.

methods.name: getUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user local time of the last action.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset of the user at the time of the last action.
